title: Tradesperson Website Cost UK: Plumbers, Electricians and Builders (2026)
meta_title: Tradesperson Website Cost UK 2026: Plumbers, Builders
meta_description: A website for a UK plumber, electrician or builder costs £349–£3,000, or £69 a month. What to include to win local jobs, and what to skip.

faq.q: How much does a plumber's website cost in the UK?
faq.a: Most plumbers need a simple site costing £349 to £750, or a monthly plan around £69. Agency builds of £3,000 or more are rarely necessary.

faq.q: What should an electrician's website include?
faq.a: One-tap call, a page per service, areas covered, reviews, accreditations like NICEIC, and a quote form.
Local SEO, yes: Google Business Profile, reviews and town pages bring most calls. Start there before paying for wider SEO.

faq.q: Is a Facebook page enough instead of a website?
faq.a: It helps, but a website ranks on Google, appears in AI answers and looks more trustworthy for bigger jobs.

faq.q: How long does a trades website take to build?
faq.a: About 1 to 2 weeks for a simple site once you've sent photos, services and areas covered.
